column3: “Mountainous lands” is rendered “the rough places,” following a different reading.
“I will give a title” is rendered “I have given you a title of honor,” and NASB adds “Though.”
“You command me” is rendered “you shall commit to Me,” and “ask me” is kept as an imperative.
NASB puts the middle in parentheses.
“In a place of a land of darkness” is rendered “In some dark land,” and “emptiness seek me” as “Seek Me in a waste place.”
“Righteousness a word” is rendered “in righteousness,” and “swear” as “swear allegiance.”
